raw_snippet: Continuously (or close to continuously) merging rank-1 LoRA adapters into the model on the same GPUs running inference felt like the right answer to that to us.
note: Rank-1 LoRA continuous merge on the inference GPUs: per-update weight changes that persist and pool, i.e. the L5 mechanism, demonstrated only as research. The post's own caveat: it 'doesn't really solve a lot of the problems of continual learning' and forgetting remains.
